primary_temporal_methodology.name: Temporal_Primary_Expanding_DC_Elo_Stacking
primary_temporal_methodology.description: Expanding-window regularized logistic stacking of Dixon-Coles and Elo draw probabilities with proportional odds redistribution
primary_temporal_methodology.training_window: Expanding historical window (all available prior seasons)
primary_temporal_methodology.selection_rationale: Demonstrated consistent season-over-season gains across 4/4 historical validation folds without sensitivity to decay half-life hyperparameter

secondary_temporal_methodology.description: Recency-weighted regularized logistic stacking with exponential decay half-life of 2.0 seasons
